title: Request for a portrait of Buddy Petit
summary: The interviewer asks Gorman about how Buddy Petit played and what he was like personally.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Okay, I was gonna ask some more about Buddy Petit since he died before I ever got to meet him. If you could tell a little bit about Buddy, how he played, what style, what he was like personally and his music and all. Well Buddy, Buddy was a man.
